incidents.title: Repeated failed SSH logins on bastion host
incidents.narrative: Authentication logs on the bastion host show several hundred failed password attempts for the root and admin accounts over forty minutes, all originating from a single overseas address.

incidents.title: Password spraying against webmail
incidents.narrative: A small number of common passwords were tried against dozens of employee mailboxes from rotating proxy addresses; two accounts were locked out and one successful sign-in was recorded from an unusual country.

incidents.title: Credential stuffing on customer portal
incidents.narrative: A large volume of login requests used email and password pairs that match a recent public leak. Most were rejected, but a handful of customer accounts were accessed before rate limiting kicked in.

incidents.title: Fake IT helpdesk email
incidents.narrative: Several staff received messages claiming to be from the helpdesk asking them to verify their mailbox quota through a link. The page imitated our sign-in portal and recorded the credentials that were typed into it.

incidents.title: Invoice attachment macro
incidents.narrative: Finance received a message with a supposed overdue invoice. Opening the spreadsheet prompted the user to enable editing, which launched a script that contacted an external server.

incidents.title: Executive impersonation payment request
incidents.narrative: An email appearing to come from the chief executive asked accounts payable to urgently wire funds to a new supplier. The sender domain differed from ours by a single character.

incidents.title: Ransom note on file share
incidents.narrative: Users reported documents they could not open. Every file in several shared folders had a new extension, and a text file in each folder demanded payment in cryptocurrency.

incidents.title: Cryptominer on build server
incidents.narrative: The build server processor stayed at full load. Investigation found an unknown process connecting to a mining pool and persisting through a scheduled job.

incidents.title: Beaconing workstation
incidents.narrative: Network monitoring flagged a workstation contacting the same external domain at regular sixty-second intervals with small encrypted payloads, consistent with command-and-control check-ins.

incidents.title: Publicly listable storage bucket
incidents.narrative: A storage container holding customer export files was configured to allow public listing. External researchers notified us after downloading sample files.

incidents.title: Bulk copy by departing employee
incidents.narrative: A user who had submitted their resignation copied several gigabytes of project archives to a personal cloud account the night before their last day.

incidents.title: Remote desktop exposed to the internet
incidents.narrative: A scan showed remote desktop reachable directly from the internet on a lab server that used a weak local administrator password. Logs showed repeated connection attempts.
